args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after failed v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in production (the v2.3.1-rc had also failed in staging — worth flagging to the team).
2. **Rolled back** all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Since v2.3.0 had a prior healthy production release, no change-manager approval was needed.
3. **Verified** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** ("checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after failed v2.3.1 deploy") with full details; the on-call engineer has been paged.
